description: This file defines functions and types related to Discord approval handling within a plugin system, including extracting session info, creating approval resolvers, and managing approval capabilities.

methods.name: extractDiscordChannelId
methods.description: Extracts the Discord channel ID from a session key string.

methods.name: extractDiscordSessionKind
methods.description: Determines the session kind ('channel', 'group', 'dm') from a session key string.

methods.name: normalizeDiscordOriginChannelId
methods.description: Normalizes a string to a Discord channel ID, handling various formats.

methods.name: shouldHandleDiscordApprovalRequest
methods.description: Determines if a Discord approval request should be handled based on configuration and filters.

methods.name: createDiscordOriginTargetResolver
methods.description: Creates a resolver for the origin target of Discord approval requests.

methods.name: createDiscordApproverDmTargetResolver
methods.description: Creates a resolver for approver DM targets in Discord approval process.

methods.name: createDiscordApprovalCapability
methods.description: Creates a capability object for Discord approval handling.

methods.name: createDiscordNativeApprovalAdapter
methods.description: Creates an adapter for native Discord approval capabilities.

methods.name: getDiscordApprovalCapability
methods.description: Returns a cached instance of the Discord approval capability.

methods.name: getDiscordNativeApprovalAdapter
methods.description: Returns a cached instance of the Discord native approval adapter.
